summary.one_liner: Popcorn Time is a streaming app for browsing and watching torrent-based movies, per its listing in the awesome-mac directory; the submitted URL instead shows a Banggood online shopping page, so the page content does not match the tool.
use_cases: shop for gadgets online in india
summary.what_it_does: The listing describes Popcorn Time as a streaming app for browsing and watching torrent-based movies, linked to the popcorn-official/popcorn-desktop GitHub project. The fetched page text, however, is the Banggood India e-commerce storefront: it shows top-selling product prices in INR, popular shopping keywords like RC toys and electric scooters, and claims of 37 overseas warehouses and 40+ payment methods. It contains no description of Popcorn Time features. The page also carries a maintenance notice about a website upgrade and customer service contacts for Danish customers. Because the URL appears to be a different site than the project, the summary of the tool relies on the listing text rather than the page.
